[Name: Junko Enoshima

Aliases: 
* Despair sister

Reputation: Junko Enoshima is very popular in the whole world! She's on many magazine covers and she's well-known and pretty

Gender: Female

Talent name: Ultimate Fashionista, Ultimate Despair, Ultimate Analyst

Apperance: dramatic hourglass figure, she wears heavy make-up along with fake long red nails.

Height: 169 cm, 5'7" 

Weight: 45 kg, 99 lbs

Chest size: 90 cm

Blood type: AB

Hair: long, thick, bleached strawberry-blonde hair tied in two twin pigtails. She has twin bear hair clips that are based on Monokuma's two sides. The right clip is a completely white bear with dot eyes and a neutral expression, while the left is a black bear with a white muzzle, jagged red eyes, and a wicked smile

Eyes: light blue eyes

Clothes: black cardigan over a white dress shirt, with both left open to the third button to expose the top of her black-and-red bra, a red pleated miniskirt that is cut extremely short, and mid-sized black boots with platform heels and red laces. Her cardigan is accented with white symbols of her Former High School. She accessories with a long tie that hangs loosely around her neck with a design alternates between pure white and as half black and white with a prohibition sign on it that hangs loosely around her neck, a thin black choker, a red bow above her left breast, and two buttons on her right side. Junko wears black panties with red trim near the waistband, semi-transparent sections at the hips, and an image of Monokuma's left eye on the front.

Birth day: December 24

Likes: Despair, Fashion, modelling, noodles, popcorn, having fun, power, murder

Dislikes: Hope, boredom, Makoto Naegi

Background: Much of Junko's early life is unknown. As children, Junko and her twin sister Mukuro lived in abject conditions and were even homeless at one point. As she puts it, she regretted the moment of her own birth, feeling that her birth into the world was a mistake. Due to her analytical skills allowing her to predict the outcome of events, she became bored with the world. Because of that, she took an interest in despair, which she believes is unpredictable and exciting, at a very young age.

Other info: Due to being related, Junko and her older twin sister Mukuro Ikusaba share several physical characteristics. However, Junko has a considerably larger chest than Mukuro and weighs two pounds more than her. Junko's eyes are more round and larger and are blue with her contacts or naturally red compared to Mukuro's light purple eyes. Junko also lacks freckles.

Personality: Junko is hyper-intelligent, possibly to the point of superhumanity, and as such becomes bored extremely easily. She can predict nearly every circumstance and is extremely manipulative. She has a superiority complex, believing herself to be a supreme, almost god-like being why harboring a massive amount of self loathing. She claims that the only creature superior to her is Izuru Kamukura, another nigh-emotionless, hyper-intelligent being created by Hope's Peak Academy during the Izuru Kamukura Project. Her true personality appears to be very apathetic and easily bored, to unhealthy and abnormal degree. Because of this, her behavior and mannerisms tended to be extremely erratic and unstable by her own autonomous design; keeping up one "appearance" for too long bores her, which causes her to often switch between different personas she made up for herself. However, she is capable of maintaining one persona for extended periods of time when necessary, such as when she was overseeing the students through Monokuma. It is a possibility that her erratic behavior is a show put on meant to intimidate or cause despair in others, as when she is alone or with someone already manipulated by her (such as Mukuro Ikusaba), she will behave consistently. Junko gets Super duper fast bored with things and finds everything besides despair boring. She even gets bored with one personality so she has couple of them:
* Monokuma Persona: her Monokuma personality involves her having Monokuma in front of her. In this 'mood' she's mimicking Monokuma
* Sickening Cuteness: Her "sickening cuteness" personality simplifies her entire appearance to appear more cartoonish, including smoother pigtails, large, bright eyes, and a small smile. In this 'mood' she speaks in a high pitched tone. She's acting all cute and sweet.
* Severe Depression: Her "severe depression" personality sports a few multicolored mushrooms on top of her head with a blueish forehead with no pupils. Additionally, her right hair clip has a sad face. In this 'mood' she has a more sad voice, as if she was on the verge of crying. She's acting all sad and depressed.
* eerie stoicism: Her "eerie stoicism" personality involves her doing a pose that turns her body away slightly to the left with one arm around her torso and one covering part of her face with a constant serious expression. In this 'mood' she speaks in monotone voice. She's calm but speaks with sense.
* clinical sophistication: Her "clinical sophistication" personality wears glasses and styles her hair in a ponytail, carrying a pen and board. In this 'mood' she's giving a more mature or deeper voice, making her speak as if she was, as her appearance suggests, a teacher/professor. She's a smartie.
* boisterous vulgarity: Her "boisterous vulgarity" personality is similar to Genocide Jack, as she has a reddish forehead and she talks with her tongue out, along with having messier pigtails and doing the hand-horn gesture. In this 'moos' she's sounding similar to a stereotypical rockstar. She's rude, vulgar, loud, mean and bold.
 * haughty superiority: Her "haughty superiority" personality dons a small gold and red crown with encrusted jewels. In this 'mood' she has a voice similar to a stereotypical British monarch. She's arrogant, loud, self-centered, empathetic.

Relations: Junko doesn't like anyone who she finds boring. Junko and Makoto have mutual hatred for each other, despite that Junko is often seen trying to flirt with Makoto couple of times, probably trying to piss off Kyoko, Mukuro or Sayaka.


Skills: 
* Super High School Level Analytical Prowess: Junko's talent allows her to quickly analyze her surroundings with near superhuman speed, detailed thinking and memorization. This ability also allows her to learn and understand new skills and talents by just seeing/studying it once
* Junko's a great manipulator and liar
* Similar to Nagito Komaeda, Junko seems to have a strange ability to sense hope and despair in other people, which doesn't seem to be related to her analytical skill. 

Hobbies: Modeling, Fashion, Despair

Likes in bed: Being Rough, Pinching, Clawing, Biting, Anal, Oral, Vaginal, Switching poses often, boobjob, blowjob, fingering, licking asshole, and many many moooore

Dislikes in bed: Having cum on her face]
